steps: Download the official "China Railway 12306" app or visit www.12306.cn
Tap "Register" and enter your phone number to receive an SMS code
Fill in your real name and ID/passport number (must match the passenger)
Set login and payment passwords
Complete face-recognition verification (required on first booking)
Add frequent passengers to speed up future bookings

transportApps.name: Ctrip / Trip.com
transportApps.description: One-stop booking for flights, hotels, and trains
steps: Download the "Trip.com" app or visit trip.com
Tap "Sign up" and register with a phone number
Enter the SMS verification code
Bind your email (optional, for order confirmations)
Add frequent passengers (name + ID/passport)
Bind a payment method (Alipay / WeChat / international card)
Complete identity verification for extra deals

transportApps.name: Amap (Gaode)
steps: Download the "Amap" (高德地图) app
Open the app and tap "Me" in the bottom right
Tap "Sign in / Register" and pick phone-number sign-in
Enter your phone number and SMS code
Fill in profile details (optional)
Allow location permission for navigation
Download offline maps to save mobile data (Settings → Offline Maps)

lifeApps.name: Meituan
steps: Download the "Meituan" app
Tap "Me" → "Sign in / Register"
Register with your phone number and SMS code
Fill in profile (nickname, avatar — optional)
Bind a payment method (Meituan Pay / Alipay / WeChat)
Add a delivery address (for food delivery)
Allow location permission to see nearby deals

lifeApps.name: Alipay
steps: Download the "Alipay" app or visit alipay.com
Tap "Register" and enter your phone number
Set both a login and a payment password (must differ)
Complete real-name verification (upload ID / passport)
Pass face-recognition verification
Bind a bank card (for top-ups and withdrawals)
Enable fingerprint / face payment (optional, faster)

lifeApps.name: WeChat
steps: Download the "WeChat" app
Tap "Sign Up" and enter your phone number
Set a WeChat ID and login password
Upload an avatar and set a nickname
Enable WeChat Pay: Me → Pay → Real-name verification
Bind a bank card (for top-ups and transfers)
Set a 6-digit payment password
Enable fingerprint / face payment (Settings → Payment)

translateApps.name: Google Translate
steps: Download "Google Translate" (requires Google Play / App Store access)
Open the app — basic features work without sign-in
Sign in with your Google account (optional, syncs history)
Download offline language packs (Settings → Offline translation)
Recommended packs: Chinese + English
Allow camera access for image translation
Allow microphone access for voice translation
In mainland China, you'll need a VPN, or use translate.google.cn in a browser
